technique_name: Write a detailed description of the Mona Lisa.
description: The Mona Lisa is one of the most famous and celebrated paintings in the world. The renowned artwork is oil on poplar wood and dates back to the Italian Renaissance period. It was painted by Leonardo da Vinci and is thought to have been completed sometime between 1503 and 1506. It features a woman with an enigmatic facial expression and mysterious smile.
